name: contract-method-registration
goal: Class and API matrices register exact canonical cases with no computed, missing, duplicate or extra callbacks

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: New class lifecycle migrations use finite matrices, but ordinary computed test titles are intentionally rejected by static discovery. Method/API cases need canonical manifest-driven registration analogous to helper Examples, retaining each original fixture and assertion.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The TestExpectationService method suite currently covers three public methods. Declare registerCases as a new fourth capability and its initialized case, asserting lazy registration, exact file/title identity, missing/extra callbacks and full API JSON result checks. Bug fixes within that new case retain its count.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The existing TestExpectationService method suite now declares the new fourth capability. Its retained b14d66e37d red fails registerCases is not a function, checkpoint440fd4fe. The same TestDiscoveryService.discover case is also strengthened for canonical method matrices; no discovery test declaration is added.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: registerCases admits only class/API contracts, validates the finite matrix, scopes callbacks to a literal canonical test file, refuses missing/extra callbacks and compares complete API JSON results. Static discovery reads the same manifest case titles. The unchanged six owning method cases pass and focused lint is clean; full verification remains pending.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged six owning method cases fail atf40d118b7d and pass at096b5f31c5 with identical command/profile. The passing checkpoint retains four TestExpectationService method cases (the fourth is the newly declared registerCases capability) and two unchanged discovery cases. Full migration and real-runner/browser acceptance remain pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
